title: Astro Portal API v1 — the files attached to a capture
description: A file attached to a capture is a file to download, never an image of the gallery: no thumbnail, no shared copy, no sky solution, no automatic check, never a variant, never the main image, never public (no gallery, no public route, no public export ever serves or names it). One role today, `linear` (« Fichier linéaire »: the calibrated, aligned stack, not stretched, for processing elsewhere — Astro Sync's « Sans traitement »); the list of roles may grow. Astro Sync sends it with `POST /v1/uploads` (either transport) naming `captureId` and `role: "linear"`; it is counted against the storage (`storage.quota_bytes`, `storage.max_file_bytes`) and nothing else — not `capture.count_limit`, not `capture.variant_limit` — and it never replaces anything. A digest is held once per space, as an image or as an attached file: the same bytes sent again are « already present » (`POST /v1/uploads/check` answers `present` with `attachmentId`). `GET /v1/captures/{id}/attachments` lists the files of a capture (`list`), `GET /v1/captures/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}` serves the bytes as a download (a device token of the space or the owner's web session), `DELETE /v1/manage/captures/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}` deletes one (the owner's web session with its CSRF token; answers the capture). The deletion of the capture deletes its attached files. See api/v1.md, « Files attached to a capture ».

role.description: What the file is to its capture. `linear`: the linear master (calibrated, aligned, not stretched), word on screen « Fichier linéaire ».

attachment.description: One file attached to a capture. `contentType` is read from the bytes (`image/tiff` for a TIFF, `application/octet-stream` for a file the service does not recognise), never from what the sender declared. `width`, `height` and `bitDepth` (bits per sample) are read from the file's header when it is a TIFF, `null` otherwise or until they are read. `createdAt` is the instant the file arrived (for a file reclassified at deployment, the instant its image had arrived).

originalName.description: The name the file was sent with, exactly; the download is served under it. Never a path.

list.description: `GET /v1/captures/{id}/attachments`: the files attached to one capture of the space, newest first (`[]` when it has none).

refusal.description: 400 `invalid_request`; 401 `authentication_required`; 403 `csrf_invalid`, `web_session_required` (a device token on the deletion); 404 `capture_not_found` (an unknown or another space's capture), `attachment_not_found` (no such file on that capture, or its bytes are no longer stored); 503 `capture_storage_unavailable`.
